title: Contract for control of the assets needed to operate and improve
text: The expanded note identifies policies, company context, evaluations, tool semantics and operational records as assets to own or contractually control. The point is practical continuity: another competent team needs enough information and access to run, diagnose and change the system.
qualification: Compiler recommendation, not legal advice or a claim that every component should be built internally.
